# DataTable

*Data display · Sortable, filterable, paginated tables of vault and invocation data.*

**Page status:** stable · Tracks WEB-33, WEB-34

**Status:** stable · **Since:** 0.1.0 · **Source:** `components/ui/DataTable.tsx:240`

DataTable — reusable table component with sorting, client-side filtering,
and pagination. (WEB-33)

## Import

```tsx
import { DataTable } from '@/components/ui/DataTable';
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `ColumnDef<T>[]` | — | Yes | Column definitions. |
| `data` | `T[]` | — | Yes | Row data. |
| `rowKey` | `(row: T, index: number) => string \| number` | — | No | Optional row key extractor. Defaults to the row index. Providing a stable key (e.g. a unique `id` field) avoids reconciliation issues when sorting / filtering. |
| `pageSize` | `number` | `0` | No | Number of rows per page. Pass 0 or undefined to disable pagination. |
| `filterKeys` | `(keyof T \| string)[]` | — | No | Keys of columns searched by the filter input. When omitted, all string/number cell values are included in the search. |
| `filterPlaceholder` | `string` | `'Filter…'` | No | Placeholder text for the filter input. |
| `emptyMessage` | `React.ReactNode` | `'No results found.'` | No | Message shown when the filtered result set is empty. |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` | — | No | Optional title rendered in the table header bar. |
| `subtitle` | `React.ReactNode` | — | No | Optional subtitle rendered below the title. |
| `className` | `string` | — | No | Additional className for the outermost container. |
| `'data-testid'` | `string` | — | No | data-testid applied to the root element (WEB-34 compatibility). |

## Usage

```tsx
const columns: ColumnDef<MyRow>[] = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', sortable: true },
  { key: 'value', header: 'Value', sortable: true, align: 'right' },
];
<DataTable columns={columns} data={rows} pageSize={10} />
```

## Accessibility

- The filter input is labelled by a visually hidden `<label>` **and** an
  `aria-label`, so it is reachable both by visible text and by name.
- Sortable headers are real `<button>` elements inside `<th scope="col">`,
  and the sorted column exposes `aria-sort` (`ascending` / `descending`).
- Pagination controls carry explicit `aria-label`s ("First page", "Next
  page", …) and use `disabled`, so the current position is announced.
- The empty state renders inside a single full-width cell, which keeps the
  table structure valid when there are no rows.

## Types

### `ColumnDef`

Column definition — T is the row type.

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `keyof T \| string` | — | Yes | Unique key matching a field in T (or a synthetic label for accessor cols). |
| `header` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Yes | Header label shown in <th>. |
| `sortable` | `boolean` | — | No | Whether this column is sortable. Defaults to false. |
| `cell` | `(row: T) => React.ReactNode` | — | No | Optional cell renderer. Receives the row and returns a React node. Falls back to `String(row[key])` when omitted. |
| `align` | `'left' \| 'center' \| 'right'` | — | No | Text alignment for both <th> and <td>. Defaults to 'left'. |
| `className` | `string` | — | No | Additional className applied to every <td> in this column. |
